#include <cassert>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

bool valid_brackets(std::string_view s)
{
    std::vector<char> stack;
    stack.reserve(s.size());

    for (char c : s)
    {
        if (c == '(' || c == '[' || c == '{')
        {
            stack.push_back(c);
        }
        else if (c == ')')
        {
            if (stack.empty() || stack.back() != '(')
                return false;
            stack.pop_back();
        }
        else if (c == ']')
        {
            if (stack.empty() || stack.back() != '[')
                return false;
            stack.pop_back();
        }
        else if (c == '}')
        {
            if (stack.empty() || stack.back() != '{')
                return false;
            stack.pop_back();
        }
    }

    return stack.empty();
}

int main()
{
    assert(valid_brackets("()"));
    assert(valid_brackets("[]"));
    assert(valid_brackets("{}"));
    assert(valid_brackets("([{}])"));
    assert(!valid_brackets("([)]"));
    assert(!valid_brackets("((("));
    assert(!valid_brackets(")))"));
    assert(valid_brackets(""));
    assert(valid_brackets("abc"));
    assert(valid_brackets("a(b)c[d]e{f}"));
    assert(!valid_brackets("([)"));
    assert(!valid_brackets("]"));
    assert(!valid_brackets("("));

    std::puts("All tests passed.");
    return 0;
}
